create_MarkerInfo: create a MarkerInfo instance to track a scene marker pinned to an articulated link
set_targ_js: set the target joint state for a marker by updating the parent articulated object joint positions
get_targ_js: get the current target joint state value for a marker from the parent articulated object
get_current_position: get the current 3D position of a marker as a numpy array from its transform
update_MarkerInfo: update a marker current transform by composing the link node transformation with its offset
